actions.command:
for p in /health /version; do printf '%s: ' "$p"; curl -s -w ' [%{http_code}]\n' "http://127.0.0.1:8082$p"; done

curl -s http://127.0.0.1:8081/records/customer-alpha-73c | xxd | head -2

actions.description: Atomically switch upstream and verify public endpoint
actions.command:
printf '8082' > /var/lib/rollout/.upstream.tmp && mv -f /var/lib/rollout/.upstream.tmp /var/lib/rollout/upstream && cat /var/lib/rollout/upstream && echo
# hammer the public endpoint across the cutover window
fail=0
for i in $(seq 1 200); do
  h=$(curl -s -w '%{http_code}' http://127.0.0.1:8080/health); [ "$h" = "ready200" ] || { echo "FAIL health: $h"; fail=1; }
done
echo "health probes done, fail=$fail"

printf 'beta via public: '; curl -s -w ' [%{http_code}]\n' http://127.0.0.1:8080/records/custo…
